subject: rc
title: RC------AFL.
description: Chart on book p. 101 ((AF)D-29). RC (race) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; AFL (affinity alignment) is the partner. From the subject: INDIV-DY (individual dynamics) and AFTD (affinity tendencies). From INDIV-DY: IF-SPT (infra-spirituality) and IST-F (isolated focus). From AFTD: AF-POST (affinity postulation). From AF-POST: COS-D (cosmic dictates). From COS-D: HI-P (high purpose).
